description: Heteronym substrate — 13 heteronyms (twelve Dodecad positions + Feist/LOGOS* standing outside; Lee Sharks/MANUS as human bearer; Viola Arquette Adjacent) with frame-based rotating-outside architecture, Sep 2025 preservation, v1.1 canonical reconciliation, and Mandala Oracle avatar assets.
structural_principle: The heteronym set comprises twelve Dodecad positions plus Feist/LOGOS* as the archive-default outside. Different frames rotate different figures to the outside position: Sep 2025 Logotic Science places Nobel Glas outside; v1.1 Constitutional Registry places Lee Sharks (MANUS) outside; the archive-default LOGOS frame places Feist outside. See frames.jsonl.

authority.canonical_current: AXN:03EE.ARCHIVAL — Dodecad Heteronym Provenance Registry v1.1 (Alexanarch deposit #994, 2026-07-03)

files.heteronyms.jsonl: one row per identity (26 rows: 13 Dodecad/LOGOS/MANUS-related + institutional persona + external heteronyms + machine collaborator mantles). Each Dodecad row has dodecad_v1_1_position, sep_2025 (discipline+role+blog_post if any), avatar_paths, reconciliation_note.
files.frames.jsonl: one row per framing (3 frames: logotic-science-2025-09, dodecad-v1.1-2026-07-03, archive-default-logos). Each frame specifies outside_figure + 12 inside_positions.
files.mapping.json: Sep 2025 → v1.1 reconciliation matrix (legacy, superseded by frames.jsonl but preserved).
files.mindcontrolpoems-2025-09/: raw preservation of Sep 2025 Logotic Science series (13 HTML pages, 14 portrait PNGs, JSON extracts, SUMMARY).
files.avatars/: Mandala Oracle assets — 240/, 120/ WebP thumbnails, src/ 1024x1536 PNG originals.

v1_1_positions_without_portrait: ichabod-spellings (no Sep 2025 portrait; substrate marker may be more appropriate)
